musicmod.tab.overview.desc: What is playing and the quick switches.
musicmod.tab.lyrics.desc: Synced lyrics in the world, where you look, and in the top bar.
musicmod.tab.styles.desc: Colors for lyrics, HUD and this menu.
musicmod.tab.hud.desc: Top pill and the info next to the hotbar.
musicmod.tab.skies.desc: Custom skies: nebula, galaxy, aurora, sunsets.
musicmod.opt.lyrics.desc: Shows the lyrics of the song you are playing.
musicmod.opt.hud.desc: Top pill (clock, song, FPS, ping) and coordinates.
musicmod.opt.highlight.desc: How the sung part is marked.
musicmod.opt.next_line.desc: Shows the upcoming line, smaller and dimmer.
musicmod.opt.offset.desc: Lyrics too early: lower it. Too late: raise it.
musicmod.opt.follow.desc: Off: each line appears where you look (on walls, standing on the ground) and stays. On: floats in front of you.
musicmod.opt.animation.desc: New lines fade in and rise.
musicmod.opt.sky_background.desc: Dark box behind the lyrics in the sky.
musicmod.opt.distance.desc: How far away the lyrics appear when you look at the sky.
musicmod.opt.height.desc: How high above your eyes (only with Follow view on).
musicmod.opt.size.desc: Size of the lyrics in the sky.
musicmod.opt.hud_ping.desc: Latency to the server (hidden in singleplayer).
musicmod.opt.hud_coords.desc: X Y Z of your position.
musicmod.opt.hud_speed.desc: Horizontal speed in blocks per second.
musicmod.lyrics.not_found: No synced lyrics for this song
musicmod.player.hint: Play something in Spotify (or YouTube in the browser).
musicmod.player.unsupported: Reading the player works on Windows only (for now).
musicmod.player.failed: Windows media controls are not available.
musicmod.overview.help: Play a song in Spotify. Musicmod finds its lyrics and shows them in the sky and in the top bar, word by word. Open this menu with M (change it in Options > Controls > Key Binds > Musicmod).
musicmod.styles.help: Left color: sung words. Middle: the word being sung now. Right: words still to come.
musicmod.btn.retry: Search lyrics again for this song
musicmod.settings.help: Lyrics are saved in config/musicmod/lyrics-cache so every song is downloaded only once.
musicmod.info.text:
Lyrics: LRCLIB (lrclib.net), free and open.
Music: read from Windows media controls, so it works with Spotify, YouTube in the browser and other players. No login, no API key.
Made by ServerGunnik.
musicmod.opt.font.desc: Font of the lyrics in the world and in the top bar.
musicmod.move.hint: Drag the elements. Click empty space to go back.
musicmod.opt.sky.desc: Pick a sky, then press Apply.
musicmod.skies.need_mod: Skies are drawn by the Skyboxify mod, which is not installed. Install Skyboxify (Modrinth) to see them.
musicmod.skies.help: Applying takes a few seconds because the game reloads its resources. The sky is saved as the resource pack "musicmod_sky"; Musicmod turns it on and off for you.
